meta.name: Carpets & kilims
meta.positioning: Real 2025+ foreign buy-side demand for this Iran-sourced product (verified + de-noised).
meta.note: Thin-to-moderate. Genuine 2026 FOREIGN buy-side demand specifically for handwoven/kilim carpets (as opposed to machine-made, hand-tufted, jute, or PVC mats) is sparse on the public web: a couple of Germany kilim importers on TradeKey, plus scattered handmade/hand-knitted carpet requests (Spain, Israel, Italy, Gulf states) on go4WorldBusiness. Most such leads are contact-gated, first-name-only, or actually sellers, so verifiable, reachable foreign buyers are few. Demand is concentrated on TradeKey (Germany importer board) and go4WorldBusiness EU/Gulf buy-leads.
